test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, DUMBLEDORE is written as DOREELDUMB and INDIVIDUAL is written as DUALIVINDI. How will APPENDICES be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8917e7e4a037fb946fafa0b16de664d6f0ce32ab76e5c2c9b848dc1f771a7f81.png] 

The logic followed here is:

DUMBLEDORE is written as DOREELDUMB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d510e1deb7d1fd7fef90d3cedaa2391f2ffb3d388c88c6193d8725317150fb6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4290917ed888da113795e8ca25cbff82077aa7bb0836dfd3b25e4cea3d2868e8.png] 

INDIVIDUAL is written as DUALIVINDI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ea678f12b8af41031bafed001c3a59100d9417a9f4ae2c1d757ac439e0a2754.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba0782e4e20c8cdc9689a33ecde8b9994885d575eff1a17b9050bc9a08edae73.png] 

Similarly, **APPENDICES **will be written:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4d654f978215628b6cd909d08649e4af36bd9ff1505d2c83ce2dbdef17bab1c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/613bdb99aff41cccd172b7eb1d68b367409ebb688d0ec55735ebbb952219d55d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "ICESDNAPPE".**
